content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user who reviews my tasks on the task reporting page","i_want":"to filter the report tasks by Status, Priority and Date Range","so_that":"I can see only the tasks that match the part of my workload I am reviewing","business_description":"The reporting page offers Status, Priority and Date Range filters. The backend report API must support filtering so that the page can show only the matching tasks. Searching, sorting and metric aggregation are covered by other stories.","business_value":"Users can narrow a long task list to the subset they need to review, without scanning every task on the page.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The report contains tasks with Open, In Progress and Completed status","when":"The user selects the status filter value Open on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose status is Open and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with Low, Medium and High priority","when":"The user selects the priority filter value High on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose priority is High and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with dates both inside and outside a chosen range","when":"The user sets a Date Range on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose date value falls inside the range; the date field used is the open question listed in the edge cases"},{"given":"The report API is called with a status, a priority or a date range filter","when":"The request is sent with one or more filter values","then":"The response contains only the tasks that match the filter values sent, and the count in the response equals the number of returned tasks"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state which date field the Date Range filter applies to (Creation Date, Due Date, Completion Date or Last Updated Date). This is an open question and must be decided before the date filter is built.","The PRD does not state whether the range bounds are inclusive. This is an open question.","The PRD does not state whether several filters combine with AND or OR. This is an open question; the API and the page must follow the same rule.","A Date Range where the start date is later than the end date is not defined by the PRD. This is an open question: the API or the page must reject it, and the wording of the message is not specified.","When no task matches the selected filters, the report table has no rows. The PRD does not specify the message or empty state for this case on the report page.","A filter value outside the allowed values (Open, In Progress, Completed for status; Low, Medium, High for priority) is invalid input and must be rejected with the error handling defined in the create task story.","Clearing a filter returns the report to the unfiltered list for that filter."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The report API accepts status, priority and date range filter parameters and returns only matching tasks.","The API rejects invalid filter values with the standard invalid input error.","The reporting page shows Status, Priority and Date Range filter controls that call the API and update the table.","The date field and combination rule for the Date Range filter are documented and implemented as decided.","Automated tests cover each filter alone, combined filters, an empty result and an invalid filter value.","No optimistic UI is used: the table updates only after the API returns the filtered result."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-tasks-filter-api","title":"[BE] Add status, priority and date range filters to the report tasks endpoint","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Extend the task report GET endpoint so it accepts optional status, priority and date range query parameters and returns only matching tasks. Validate values against the allowed Status and Priority values and reject invalid input. Searching, sorting and metric aggregation are implemented in other stories and are not part of this task.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint accepts status, priority and date range parameters, each optional.","Only tasks matching all supplied filter values are returned, following the combination rule documented in the open question.","Invalid status, priority or date values return the standard invalid input error.","Filter queries read the stored tasks table created by the create task story."]},{"key_slug":"report-filter-controls","title":"[FE] Add Status, Priority and Date Range filter controls to the report page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add Status and Priority selectors and a Date Range control to the task reporting page. Changing a filter calls the report endpoint with the filter values and renders the returned tasks in the report table. Show the loading and error states while the request runs.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Status, Priority and Date Range controls are visible on the reporting page.","Each filter change calls the filtered report endpoint and updates the table only after the response arrives.","Clearing a filter restores the unfiltered results for that filter.","Loading and error states are shown while the filtered request runs or fails."]},{"key_slug":"report-filter-tests","title":"[QA] Test suite for report task filters","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Write the automated tests for the report filters: API tests for each filter, combined filters, empty results and invalid values, and UI tests for the filter controls and the resulting table rows.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c","R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["API tests cover status, priority and date range filters, combined filters, empty results and invalid values.","UI tests cover selecting each filter and checking the visible table rows.","All tests pass in the continuous integration pipeline."]}]}
